items.en:
CA2 Anomaly Aware Routing and Blocking Controller
AY 2026 27 Semester 1 | Experiments on 11, 16 and 17 October 2026
items.zh:
CA2 异常感知路由与源地址封锁控制器
2026—2027 学年第一学期｜实验日期：2026 年 10 月 11、16、17 日

items.en: Abstract
items.zh: 摘要

items.en: This report presents an integrated OpenFlow controller for the supplied six-switch mesh. It measures source traffic, detects abnormal rates using an exponential moving average, blocks the offending IPv4 source, updates directed link costs, and reroutes legitimate traffic when another route becomes cheaper. The implementation and measurements are organized around Tasks 1 to 5 of the laboratory assignment [1].
items.zh: 本报告围绕教师提供的六交换机网状拓扑，实现并评价集成 OpenFlow 控制器。控制器监测源流量，以指数移动平均建立基线并识别异常，封锁异常 IPv4 源地址，更新有向链路代价，并在替代路线更便宜时切换合法流量。正文按照实验作业 Task 1 至 Task 5 组织 [1]。

items.en: Five student-operated trials were analysed: one each for cases A and C and three for case B. With a 10 Mbps h1→h6 UDP offered load, case B changed from s1→s2→s6 to s1→s2→s3→s6 and recovered after the anomaly. A and C retained the original legitimate route because their affected links were outside it. All one-second receiver intervals carried traffic. B had brief loss near anomaly onset, with whole-run loss rates of 0.0843%, 0.1529% and 0.0431%; A and C had no observed UDP loss.
items.zh: 共分析五轮学生亲自操作的实验：A、C 场景各一轮，B 场景三轮。在 h1→h6 提供 10 Mbps UDP 流量的条件下，B 场景由 s1→s2→s6 切换至 s1→s2→s3→s6，并在异常结束后恢复。A、C 的异常链路不在合法原路上，因此合法路线保持不变。所有一秒接收窗口均有流量。B 在异常启动附近短暂丢包，三轮整轮丢包率为 0.0843%、0.1529%、0.0431%；A、C 未观察到 UDP 丢包。

items.en: Case C explicitly constrains the h5→h6 test pair to the direct s5→s6 link. This experimental condition is disclosed in Sections 4 and 5; it does not represent the unconstrained shortest route of that pair. Results establish behaviour under the tested workload, without claiming optimal parameters or a causal performance gain over blocking alone.
items.zh: C 场景将 h5→h6 测试对显式固定经过直接 s5→s6 链路。第 4、5 节说明这一实验条件；该测试对未使用无约束最短路线。结果仅支持当前测试负载下的行为，不声称参数最优，也不声称已证明改道相对于仅封锁的独立性能收益。

items.en: Report structure
items.zh: 报告结构

items.en: 1 Topology and baseline · 2 Monitoring and blocking · 3 Dynamic costs · 4 Rerouting and scenarios · 5 Performance evaluation · 6 Conclusions and disclosure · Appendix Reproduction and evidence
items.zh: 1 拓扑与正常基线　2 监测与封锁　3 动态代价　4 改道机制与三场景　5 性能评价　6 结论与声明　附录：复现与证据索引

zh: 1 Task 1 在 MiniEdit 中搭建拓扑

items.en: The supplied ceg_mesh_topo.py defines the network [2]. Its hosts, switches and links were reproduced in MiniEdit, saved as ca2-mesh-my.mn, reopened and run. The running topology contains six hosts, six switches and one remote controller. The 17 data links consist of six host attachments and 11 switch links; the red dotted controller connections are control channels and are not counted as data links.
items.zh: 教师提供的 ceg_mesh_topo.py 定义了网络 [2]。按照该文件在 MiniEdit 中重建主机、交换机和链路，保存为 ca2-mesh-my.mn，重新打开并运行。网络包含六台主机、六台交换机和一个远程控制器。17 条数据链路由六条主机接入链路和十一条交换机链路组成；图中的红色控制连接不计入数据链路。

items.en: Figure 1 Student MiniEdit topology screenshot with h1 to h6, s1 to s6 and c0.
items.zh: 图 1 学生保存的 MiniEdit 拓扑原图，包含 h1 至 h6、s1 至 s6 和 c0。

rows.en: s1…s6 use DPID 1…6, encoded as 16 hex digits
rows.zh: s1…s6 对应 DPID 1…6，编码为 16 位十六进制数

rows.en: All 17 links: 40 Mbps; each host link: 15 ms
rows.zh: 全部 17 条链路为 40 Mbps；每条主机链路延迟 15 ms

items.en: Host hi connects to si port 1. MiniEdit link properties provide TCLink bandwidth and delay settings; switch properties provide DPID and OpenFlow version. The saved file, actual Linux interfaces and Open vSwitch state were checked together, so the diagram alone is not the configuration evidence.
items.zh: hi 接入 si 的端口 1。MiniEdit 的链路属性设置 TCLink 带宽及延迟，交换机属性设置 DPID 和 OpenFlow 版本。实验同时核对保存文件、Linux 实际接口和 Open vSwitch 状态，因此配置依据不仅是拓扑示意图。

zh: 延迟 ms 与基础代价
延迟 ms 与基础代价

items.en: Each switch link has the listed emulated delay and original routing weight. A physical link is represented by two directed graph edges, giving 22 directed switch edges. The original h1→h6 route is s1→s2→s6 with base weight 5 + 14 = 19. The alternative s1→s2→s3→s6 has base weight 5 + 10 + 7 = 22. These are routing weights; measured round-trip delay also includes both host links, the return path and scheduling.
items.zh: 每条交换机链路使用表中的模拟延迟与原始路由权重。每条物理链路建模为两个有向图边，共 22 个有向交换机边。h1→h6 原路为 s1→s2→s6，基础代价 5 + 14 = 19；替代路线 s1→s2→s3→s6 的基础代价为 5 + 10 + 7 = 22。这里计算的是选路权重，实测往返时延还包含两端接入链路、返回路线和调度影响。

items.en: Figure 2 Baseline flow-table evidence. s1-eth2 leads to s2; s2-eth6 leads to s6; s6-eth1 leads to h6.
items.zh: 图 2 正常基线流表证据。s1-eth2 通往 s2，s2-eth6 通往 s6，s6-eth1 通往 h6。

items.en: The baseline controller discovers switches and links using LLDP, uses fixed host attachments with proxy ARP to avoid mesh broadcast loops, and installs Dijkstra routes for all 30 distinct ordered host pairs. Pingall received 30/30; h1→h6 received 5/5 with average RTT 101.139 ms. Two separate 15-second 10 Mbps UDP checks each reported 10.0 Mbps and 0/12,759 lost datagrams. This baseline precedes the integrated anomaly trials [5].
items.zh: 基线控制器通过 LLDP 发现交换机及链路，使用固定主机接入信息和代理 ARP 避免网状广播环路，并为 30 个不同源目的有向主机对安装 Dijkstra 路线。pingall 收到 30/30；h1→h6 收到 5/5，平均 RTT 为 101.139 ms。两轮独立的 15 秒、10 Mbps UDP 基线均报告 10.0 Mbps，丢包均为 0/12,759。该基线测试发生在集成异常实验之前 [5]。

en: 2 Task 2 Monitoring anomaly detection and blocking
zh: 2 Task 2 流量监测 异常检测与封锁

items.en: Flow and port statistics are polled every second. Per-source packet rate is computed only at the source host attachment, avoiding counting the same packet once at every switch along its route. Counters are differenced using actual elapsed time. Counter resets are rebased, and multipart replies are assembled before processing.
items.zh: 控制器每秒轮询流表和端口统计。每个源的包速率只在源主机接入交换机统计，避免同一数据包沿途经过多台交换机时被重复累计。速率由累计计数按实际时间差分得到；计数器重置时重新建立差分起点，分段统计回复先汇总再处理。

items.en:
rs(k) = ΔNs / Δt
Ts(k) = max(2000, 3Es(k-1))
items.zh:
rs(k) = ΔNs / Δt
Ts(k) = max(2000, 3Es(k-1))

items.en: E<sub>s</sub>(k) = 0.3r<sub>s</sub>(k) + 0.7E<sub>s</sub>(k-1)
items.zh: E<sub>s</sub>(k) = 0.3r<sub>s</sub>(k) + 0.7E<sub>s</sub>(k-1)

items.en: After five valid warm-up samples, r<sub>s</sub> > T<sub>s</sub> flags the source. The decision uses the previous EMA, and an anomalous or already blocked sample does not update the EMA. The 2000 pps floor prevents low or idle baselines from making ordinary 10 Mbps UDP traffic anomalous. ICMP echo replies are excluded from source anomaly detection so the responding victim is not blamed for the attacker’s requests. These are implementation choices extending the teacher EMA example [3].
items.zh: 至少五个有效预热样本后，若 r<sub>s</sub> > T<sub>s</sub>，则标记异常源。判断使用更新前的 EMA，异常或已封锁样本不更新 EMA。2000 pps 下限避免空闲或低速基线使普通 10 Mbps UDP 被误判。检测排除 ICMP echo reply，避免将响应攻击请求的受害主机误判为攻击源。这些设置是在教师 EMA 示例 [3] 基础上的实现选择。

items.en: Figure 3 Normal h2 ping produces approximately 2 pps and an EMA approaching 1.9 pps without blocking.
items.zh: 图 3 h2 正常 ping 约为 2 pps，EMA 逐步接近 1.9 pps，未触发封锁。

items.en: An 8-second h2→h6 ICMP flood was detected at 13,339.8 pps against a 2000 pps threshold. A priority-5000 IPv4 source drop rule was installed on all six switches. At s2 the rule had dropped 478,615 packets when inspected; subsequent h2 ping received 0/3 while h1 ping received 3/3. During the complete background observation, legitimate ping received 292/293, so this stage is not described as loss-free. Higher-priority source drops override the forwarding rules [6].
items.zh: 8 秒 h2→h6 ICMP flood 的检测速率为 13,339.8 pps，高于 2000 pps 阈值。控制器在全部六台交换机安装 priority 5000 的 IPv4 源地址丢弃规则。检查时 s2 已丢弃 478,615 包；之后 h2 ping 收到 0/3，而 h1 收到 3/3。完整后台观测中合法 ping 为 292/293，因此本阶段不能描述为零丢包。高优先级源封锁规则覆盖普通转发规则 [6]。

zh: 3 Task 3 动态链路代价更新

items.en: Each directed switch link receives an independent cost. R<sub>ij</sub> is derived from the destination switch port’s rx_bytes increase, representing traffic arriving across that directed link. Source-port tx_bytes is retained as a diagnostic. The assignment’s load-plus-anomaly form [1] is instantiated as follows; θ denotes the EMA coefficient, while the load weight is 5.
items.zh: 每条有向交换机链路独立计算代价。R<sub>ij</sub> 由目的交换机对应端口 rx_bytes 的增量获得，表示沿该有向链路实际到达的流量；源端口 tx_bytes 作为辅助诊断记录。按照作业中的“负载项加异常项”形式 [1]，本实现使用以下参数；EMA 系数记为 θ，负载权重取 5。

items.en: U<sub>ij</sub>(t) = clip(R<sub>ij</sub>(t) / 40,000,000, 0, 1)
items.zh: U<sub>ij</sub>(t) = clip(R<sub>ij</sub>(t) / 40,000,000, 0, 1)

items.en: C<sub>ij</sub>(t) = C<sup>0</sup><sub>ij</sub> + 5U<sub>ij</sub>(t) + 60A<sub>ij</sub>(t)
items.zh: C<sub>ij</sub>(t) = C<sup>0</sup><sub>ij</sub> + 5U<sub>ij</sub>(t) + 60A<sub>ij</sub>(t)

items.en: A<sub>ij</sub> = 1 on directed edges of the detected attack path while its penalty is active; otherwise A<sub>ij</sub> = 0. A penalty lasts at least 8 seconds and is removed only after 5 seconds without ingress drop-counter activity. Stale statistics do not justify clearing a penalty. This prevents immediate cost recovery merely because blocking has stopped attack packets reaching the remote link. Source blocking remains installed after the cost recovers.
items.zh: 检测到的攻击路径上，惩罚生效期间的有向边取 A<sub>ij</sub> = 1，否则取 0。惩罚至少保持 8 秒，并在源入口 drop 计数连续 5 秒无活动后才撤销。统计过期不能作为撤销惩罚的依据。这样可避免“攻击被入口封锁、远端链路不再收到攻击包”导致代价立刻恢复。链路代价恢复后，源地址封锁仍保留。

rows.zh: 撤销惩罚 仍有合法负载

items.en: Figure 4 Dynamic-cost stage shows source blocking and the additional 60-unit penalty on s2→s6.
items.zh: 图 4 动态代价阶段：异常源被封锁，s2→s6 增加 60 单位惩罚。

items.en: This isolated cost test deliberately retained static forwarding. Its 60-second UDP report was 9.99 Mbps with 44/51,024 lost datagrams, approximately 0.086%. It validates cost evolution, not rerouting. Task 4 subsequently enables route changes in the integrated controller [7].
items.zh: 这一独立代价测试有意保留静态转发。60 秒 UDP 报告为 9.99 Mbps，丢失 44/51,024 个数据报，约 0.086%。它验证代价变化，不用于证明改道；Task 4 的集成控制器随后启用路线更新 [7]。

en: 4 Task 4 Integrated rerouting design and procedure
zh: 4 Task 4 集成改道设计与实验流程

items.en: Selecting and installing routes
items.zh: 选择并安装路线

items.en: The controller extends the supplied routing example [4] by applying Dijkstra with current directed costs. For each unblocked source pair, it changes route only when the new route is at least 1 cost unit cheaper and at least 3 seconds have passed since the last change. The improvement margin and hold time reduce small load-induced oscillations. The source-drop priority is 5000, above ingress forwarding priorities 100, 109 and 110 and tagged transit priority 200.
items.zh: 控制器在教师路由示例 [4] 基础上，以当前有向代价运行 Dijkstra。对未被封锁的源目的对，只有新路线至少便宜 1 单位、且距离上次切换至少 3 秒时才更新。改善门槛和保持时间减少轻微负载波动引起的反复切换。源封锁优先级为 5000，高于入口转发的 100、109、110 和带标签中转规则的 200。

items.en: A route change uses an internal VLAN version. First, downstream rules for a new label are prepared and OpenFlow barriers are confirmed. Next, the untagged source-ingress rule is modified to attach the new label and use the new output port; another barrier confirms completion. The destination switch removes the tag. Old versions remain for 5 seconds before cookie-specific deletion. This ordering lets packets already in flight follow their previous route and preserves source counters and drop rules. The finite retention time is an engineering safeguard, not an unconditional zero-loss guarantee.
items.zh: 路线更新使用内部 VLAN 版本。先准备新标签对应的下游规则，并等待 OpenFlow barrier 确认；再修改源入口的无标签规则，为新包附加新标签并选择新出口，随后再次确认 barrier。目的交换机去掉标签。旧版本保留 5 秒后按专用 cookie 删除。这一顺序使在途包可继续使用旧路线，并保留源统计与封锁规则。有限保留时间是工程保护措施，不构成无条件零丢包保证。

items.en: Common experimental timeline
items.zh: 统一实验时间线

rows.en: Start continuous h1→h6 UDP at 10 Mbps and concurrent ping
rows.zh: 持续运行 h1→h6 的 10 Mbps UDP，并同时 ping

rows.en: Start a 14-second hping3 ICMP flood for the selected case
rows.zh: 按场景运行持续 14 秒的 hping3 ICMP flood

rows.en: Stop the flood; observe cost and legitimate-route recovery
rows.zh: 异常发送停止，观察代价及合法路线恢复

rows.en: Probe legitimate connectivity and continued source blocking
rows.zh: 测试合法连通性与异常源仍被封锁

items.en: A uses h2→h3 on s2→s3; B uses h2→h6 on s2→s6; C uses h5→h6 on s5→s6. A fresh controller and topology state are used for each round because source blocking is persistent. UDP is iperf2 with 1470-byte datagrams and 1-second receiver reporting. Every second, actual flow actions, VLAN labels, output-port peers and packet counters are inspected to corroborate the installed h1→h6 route.
items.zh: A 为 h2→h3，对应 s2→s3；B 为 h2→h6，对应 s2→s6；C 为 h5→h6，对应 s5→s6。源封锁持续保留，因此每轮使用重新启动的控制器和拓扑状态。iperf2 发送 1470 字节 UDP 数据报，接收端按秒报告。每秒核对实际流表动作、VLAN 标签、出口端口连接与包计数，确认 h1→h6 已安装的真实路线。

items.en: Case C requires an explicit injection condition: only the h5→h6 IPv4 test pair is pinned to direct s5→s6. Without this constraint its original shortest path is s5→s3→s6, cost 9 + 7 = 16, below the direct-link cost 20. Other host pairs remain dynamically routed and the original link weights are unchanged. Instructional confirmation of this test constraint remains necessary.
items.zh: C 场景需要显式施压条件：仅将 h5→h6 IPv4 测试对固定经过直接 s5→s6。无此限制时，其原始最短路为 s5→s3→s6，代价 9 + 7 = 16，低于直接链路的 20。其他主机对仍动态选路，原始链路权重不变。这一测试约束仍需教师或助教确认。

en: 4 Case A Anomaly on s2 to s3
zh: 4 场景 A 异常位于 s2 至 s3

items.en: The flood is generated by h2→h3, targeting s2→s3. Detection installs the source block, and the target edge receives the anomaly penalty. Its idle, penalized and recovered costs follow 10 → approximately 70 → 10. Under ordinary legitimate load, a used link also carries its measured load term.
items.zh: 由 h2→h3 产生 flood，目标链路为 s2→s3。检测触发源封锁，并对目标边施加异常惩罚。目标边空闲、惩罚生效和恢复后的代价依次为 10 → 约 70 → 10。正常合法流量经过的链路还包含实测负载项。

items.en: The sampled peak target-link arrival rate is 8.68 Mbps. The source is detected at 16,455.6 pps against a 2000 pps threshold. After ingress blocking and traffic drainage, the target-link arrival rate falls near idle while the penalty remains active until the quiet condition is met.
items.zh: 目标链路采样到达速率峰值为 8.68 Mbps；异常源检测速率为 16,455.6 pps，阈值为 2000 pps。入口封锁且在途流量排空后，目标链路到达速率降至接近空闲，而惩罚继续保持至满足安静期。

items.en: Figure 5 Case A normalized target-link cost, receiver UDP loss and throughput. B shows trial 1. Shading denotes the planned 12–26 s flood period; event markers use controller records.
items.zh: 图 5 场景 A 的目标链路归一化代价、接收端 UDP 丢包率和吞吐。B 图使用第 1 轮。阴影表示计划 12–26 秒 flood 时段，事件标记来自控制器记录。

items.en: The legitimate path remains s1→s2→s6. Its original route does not traverse s2→s3, and the unaffected original route remains preferable. No reroute is required simply because an anomaly exists elsewhere.
items.zh: 合法路线保持 s1→s2→s6。原路不经过 s2→s3，未受影响的原路仍然更优。因此不能因为网络其他位置发生异常就要求合法流量一定改道。

items.en: The 60-second receiver report is 10 Mbps, with 0/51,024 lost UDP datagrams (0.0000%). The source-ingress drop count at recovery review is 905,435. Post-measurement checks received 3/3 legitimate ping replies and 0/2 replies from the blocked source. Source drops were retained across all sampled switches [9].
items.zh: 60 秒接收报告为 10 Mbps，UDP 丢失 0/51,024（0.0000%）。恢复核验时源入口 drop 计数为 905,435。测量后合法 ping 收到 3/3，异常源收到 0/2；所有采样交换机的源封锁规则均保留。

en: 4 Case B Anomaly on s2 to s6
zh: 4 场景 B 异常位于 s2 至 s6

items.en: The flood is generated by h2→h6, targeting s2→s6. Detection installs the source block, and the target edge receives the anomaly penalty. Its idle, penalized and recovered costs follow 14 → approximately 75–77 → 14. Under ordinary legitimate load, a used link also carries its measured load term.
items.zh: 由 h2→h6 产生 flood，目标链路为 s2→s6。检测触发源封锁，并对目标边施加异常惩罚。目标边空闲、惩罚生效和恢复后的代价依次为 14 → 约 75–77 → 14。正常合法流量经过的链路还包含实测负载项。

items.en: The sampled peak target-link arrival rate is 25.01 Mbps. The source is detected at 36,017.9 pps against a 2000 pps threshold. After ingress blocking and traffic drainage, the target-link arrival rate falls near idle while the penalty remains active until the quiet condition is met.
items.zh: 目标链路采样到达速率峰值为 25.01 Mbps；异常源检测速率为 36,017.9 pps，阈值为 2000 pps。入口封锁且在途流量排空后，目标链路到达速率降至接近空闲，而惩罚继续保持至满足安静期。

items.en: Figure 6 Case B normalized target-link cost, receiver UDP loss and throughput. B shows trial 1. Shading denotes the planned 12–26 s flood period; event markers use controller records.
items.zh: 图 6 场景 B 的目标链路归一化代价、接收端 UDP 丢包率和吞吐。B 图使用第 1 轮。阴影表示计划 12–26 秒 flood 时段，事件标记来自控制器记录。

items.en: The legitimate path changes s1→s2→s6 → s1→s2→s3→s6 → s1→s2→s6. The anomaly penalty makes the original route expensive, and the alternative avoids s2→s6. Recovery removes the penalty and returns traffic to the cheaper original route.
items.zh: 合法路线依次为 s1→s2→s6、s1→s2→s3→s6、s1→s2→s6。异常惩罚使原路变贵，替代路线避开 s2→s6；撤销惩罚后，流量返回重新变得便宜的原路线。

items.en: The 60-second receiver report is 9.99 Mbps, with 43/51,024 lost UDP datagrams (0.0843%). The source-ingress drop count at recovery review is 888,103. Post-measurement checks received 3/3 legitimate ping replies and 0/2 replies from the blocked source. Source drops were retained across all sampled switches [9]. For B, the lowest one-second throughput was 9.47 Mbps and peak one-second loss was 5.0708%.
items.zh: 60 秒接收报告为 9.99 Mbps，UDP 丢失 43/51,024（0.0843%）。恢复核验时源入口 drop 计数为 888,103。测量后合法 ping 收到 3/3，异常源收到 0/2；所有采样交换机的源封锁规则均保留。B 的最低一秒吞吐为 9.47 Mbps，最高一秒丢包率为 5.0708%。

en: 4 Case C Anomaly on s5 to s6
zh: 4 场景 C 异常位于 s5 至 s6

items.en: The flood is generated by h5→h6, targeting s5→s6. Detection installs the source block, and the target edge receives the anomaly penalty. Its idle, penalized and recovered costs follow 20 → approximately 80 → 20. Under ordinary legitimate load, a used link also carries its measured load term.
items.zh: 由 h5→h6 产生 flood，目标链路为 s5→s6。检测触发源封锁，并对目标边施加异常惩罚。目标边空闲、惩罚生效和恢复后的代价依次为 20 → 约 80 → 20。正常合法流量经过的链路还包含实测负载项。

items.en: The sampled peak target-link arrival rate is 9.17 Mbps. The source is detected at 25,340.8 pps against a 2000 pps threshold. After ingress blocking and traffic drainage, the target-link arrival rate falls near idle while the penalty remains active until the quiet condition is met.
items.zh: 目标链路采样到达速率峰值为 9.17 Mbps；异常源检测速率为 25,340.8 pps，阈值为 2000 pps。入口封锁且在途流量排空后，目标链路到达速率降至接近空闲，而惩罚继续保持至满足安静期。

items.en: Figure 7 Case C normalized target-link cost, receiver UDP loss and throughput. B shows trial 1. Shading denotes the planned 12–26 s flood period; event markers use controller records.
items.zh: 图 7 场景 C 的目标链路归一化代价、接收端 UDP 丢包率和吞吐。B 图使用第 1 轮。阴影表示计划 12–26 秒 flood 时段，事件标记来自控制器记录。

items.en: The legitimate path remains s1→s2→s6 because it does not use s5→s6. The anomalous source is h5, so its blocking does not match h1 traffic. This is a prescribed-link injection test under the explicit pair-pinning condition described above.
items.zh: 合法路线保持 s1→s2→s6，因为该路线不使用 s5→s6。异常源为 h5，其源封锁不会匹配 h1 流量。本场景是在前述测试对固定路径条件下，对作业指定链路施压。

items.en: The 60-second receiver report is 10 Mbps, with 0/51,024 lost UDP datagrams (0.0000%). The source-ingress drop count at recovery review is 898,283. Post-measurement checks received 3/3 legitimate ping replies and 0/2 replies from the blocked source. Source drops were retained across all sampled switches [9].
items.zh: 60 秒接收报告为 10 Mbps，UDP 丢失 0/51,024（0.0000%）。恢复核验时源入口 drop 计数为 898,283。测量后合法 ping 收到 3/3，异常源收到 0/2；所有采样交换机的源封锁规则均保留。

en: 5 Task 5 Performance metrics and phase comparison
zh: 5 Task 5 性能指标与阶段比较

items.en: Normalized link cost is C<sub>ij</sub>(t)/C<sup>0</sup><sub>ij</sub>. The denominators are 10 for A, 14 for B and 20 for C. A value of 1 means the base routing cost, not 100% utilization. A common absolute anomaly penalty therefore creates different normalized heights across cases; the heights do not measure relative attack strength.
items.zh: 链路归一化代价为 C<sub>ij</sub>(t)/C<sup>0</sup><sub>ij</sub>，A、B、C 分母分别为 10、14、20。数值 1 表示基础路由代价，并非 100% 利用率。相同绝对异常惩罚会在不同场景形成不同归一化高度，不能据此比较攻击强弱。

items.en: UDP loss (%) = 100 × lost datagrams / total datagrams
items.zh: UDP loss (%) = 100 × lost datagrams / total datagrams

items.en: Throughput is the receiver’s iperf Mbps report, not the configured sender rate. Curves contain the original one-second windows without smoothing. Whole-run loss uses the final server report relayed to the client; one-second receiver bins can have slightly different end boundaries. Throughput values retain their input display precision. Stable-window throughput below is a duration-weighted mean of the reported receiver intervals.
items.zh: 吞吐取接收端 iperf 的 Mbps 报告，不以发送端配置速率代替。曲线保留原始一秒窗口，不做平滑。整轮丢包使用客户端转述的最终服务端报告；接收端逐秒窗口的末端边界可能略有不同。吞吐保留原始显示精度，下表稳定窗口吞吐为接收窗口报告按持续时间加权平均。

items.en: Table values in the second table are Mbps; every listed stable window has 0% observed UDP loss. These windows deliberately exclude the onset transition near 12–14 seconds. The stable-window zeros do not erase the transient loss shown by the complete time series.
items.zh: 第二张表的数值单位为 Mbps，所列每个稳定窗口的 UDP 观测丢包率均为 0%。这些窗口有意避开约 12–14 秒启动过渡段；稳定窗口零丢包不能否认完整时间曲线中的短时丢包。

items.en: For A, C, B2 and B3, the sender launch timestamp supplies the time origin. B1 uses an estimate from sampling metadata because its original start metadata was unavailable. Receiver bins start at the first received datagram. Controller events and receiver intervals are aligned at approximately one-second resolution, not synchronized at millisecond precision. The end of the shaded flood period is the scheduled timeout, rather than an independently timestamped process exit.
items.zh: A、C、B2、B3 以发送进程启动时间为时间原点；B1 因原始启动元数据缺失，按采样元数据估计。接收窗口从第一份数据报到达开始计时。因此控制器事件与接收窗口仅约按一秒级对齐，没有毫秒级同步。阴影终点是计划 timeout 时间，不是独立测得的进程退出时刻。

en: 5 Path costs explain the case B route change
zh: 5 路径代价解释 B 场景的改道

items.en: Figure 8 Case B trial 1 candidate route costs, observed installed path and receiver performance.
items.zh: 图 8 B 场景第 1 轮：候选路线代价、实测安装路线与接收性能。

items.en: In the normal stable period, the original path cost is approximately 21.57 and the alternative 23.28. With the anomaly penalty active, the original reaches approximately 80.35 while the alternative is approximately 25.80; switching is justified by the lower current path cost. After recovery, approximately 21.58 versus 23.29 again favours the original path. These are dynamic path costs including load. The base costs remain 19 and 22.
items.zh: 正常稳定阶段，原路线动态代价约 21.57，替代路线约 23.28。异常惩罚生效时，原路线约 80.35，替代路线约 25.80，因此切换符合当前更低总代价的选路原则。恢复后约 21.58 对 23.29，原路线重新占优。这些数值包含负载项，基础代价仍分别为 19 和 22。

items.en: The path strip is supported by actual ingress labels and downstream output rules, interface peers and increasing packet counters. It is not inferred solely from a controller ROUTE message. Cost snapshots and flow inspections are asynchronous, so small visual offsets between a cost change, an event marker and a path sample are not used to assert sub-second causal ordering.
items.zh: 路径条带由实际入口标签、下游输出规则、接口连接关系和递增包计数共同支持，并非仅从控制器 ROUTE 打印推断。代价快照与流表探测是异步的，因此不能利用图中细微错位声称亚秒级因果先后。

items.en: Three separate B trials used the same nominal configuration. All are shown, including the first and least favourable observations. This repeat study supplements the assignment’s required three anomaly locations; it does not replace cases A and C.
items.zh: 三轮独立 B 实验使用相同名义配置，图中保留全部结果，包括最初一轮和表现较差的一轮。重复测量用于补充作业要求的三种异常位置，不能替代 A、C 场景。

items.en: Figure 9 All three B trials with normalized s2→s6 cost, UDP receiver loss and receiver throughput. Curves are individual observations, not a pooled average.
items.zh: 图 9 三轮 B 实验的 s2→s6 归一化代价、UDP 接收丢包率和吞吐。曲线分别代表各轮观测，不是合并平均曲线。

items.en: All three trials rerouted to s1→s2→s3→s6 and later returned to s1→s2→s6. Their whole-run loss mean is 0.0934%, sample standard deviation 0.0554 percentage points, and range 0.0431%–0.1529%. Pooled loss is 143/153,072 datagrams, also 0.0934%. These are descriptive statistics for three observations, without a confidence interval or long-term reliability claim.
items.zh: 三轮均切换至 s1→s2→s3→s6，随后返回 s1→s2→s6。整轮丢包率均值为 0.0934%，样本标准差为 0.0554 个百分点，范围 0.0431%–0.1529%。合并丢失 143/153,072 个数据报，比例同为 0.0934%。这些只是三次观测的描述统计，不提供置信区间或长期可靠性保证。

zh: 5 丢包 连通性与恢复的解释

items.en: Short transitions and stable delivery
items.zh: 短时过渡与稳定接收

items.en: B1 lost 43/848 datagrams in its 12–13 second interval. B2 lost 51/850 in 12–13 seconds and 27/847 in 13–14 seconds. B3 lost 22/848 in 12–13 seconds. Outside these intervals, no UDP loss was observed in these three B receiver time series. Every one-second interval had positive throughput, and the stable anomaly windows returned to approximately 10 Mbps.
items.zh: B1 在 12–13 秒丢失 43/848 个数据报；B2 在 12–13 秒丢失 51/850、13–14 秒丢失 27/847；B3 在 12–13 秒丢失 22/848。三轮 B 的接收时间曲线中，其余窗口未观察到 UDP 丢包。全部一秒窗口吞吐大于零，异常稳定阶段恢复至约 10 Mbps。

items.en: The flood command does not impose a fixed packets-per-second rate. CPU scheduling, traffic generation, queue state and the polling phase may differ across runs. The evidence locates the disruption near anomaly onset, but does not isolate a single cause for every lost packet. No no-rerouting control with identical blocking was measured, so an independent numerical benefit of rerouting over blocking alone cannot be estimated.
items.zh: flood 命令没有固定每秒发送包数，CPU 调度、流量生成、队列状态及轮询相位均可能随实验变化。证据表明扰动位于异常启动附近，但无法为每个丢包确定单一原因。没有进行“保留相同检测封锁而关闭改道”的对照实验，因此无法量化改道相对于仅封锁的独立收益。

items.en: Connectivity and source isolation are distinct
items.zh: 合法连通与源隔离分别验证

items.en: Post-measurement ping succeeded for h1→h6 (3/3) and failed for the blocked source (0/2) in every integrated trial. All sampled switches retained their source-drop entries during rerouting, old-version cleanup and recovery. Continued legitimate reception and blocked-source probes together support selective isolation. They do not mean that no attack packets passed before the detection decision.
items.zh: 每轮集成实验测量后，h1→h6 ping 均为 3/3，异常源均为 0/2。采样显示改道、旧版本清理和恢复过程中，各交换机源封锁项均保留。合法持续接收与异常源探测受阻共同支持选择性隔离，但不表示检测决策前没有任何攻击包通过。

items.en: Continuous ICMP logs reported 121 sent and 120 received in each integrated trial. The missing final sequence is consistent with an in-flight packet at cleanup, but packet capture did not establish its cause. This ICMP statistic is retained separately from the UDP loss curves. The report therefore does not assert zero ICMP loss.
items.zh: 每轮集成实验的持续 ICMP 原始日志均为发送 121、接收 120。最后一个序号未收到，与清理时仍有在途包的情况相容，但没有抓包确定其原因。ICMP 统计与 UDP 丢包曲线分别记录，因此报告不声称 ICMP 零丢包。

items.en: Recovery preserves blocking
items.zh: 恢复代价但保留封锁

items.en: After the flood stops and the quiet period expires, the anomaly term disappears and the legitimate route may return. The source remains blocked until a fresh experiment restarts the state. Any new packet from an already blocked source reactivates a short penalty on its last recorded attack path. The script’s two blocked-source pings after 60 seconds therefore can cause an additional route excursion; these events are excluded from the formal 0–60 second performance window.
items.zh: flood 停止且满足安静期后，异常代价项撤销，合法路线可以恢复；异常源保持封锁，直到新一轮重启状态。已封锁源的新包会对最后记录的攻击路径重新激活短期惩罚。因此脚本在 60 秒后发送的两次异常源 ping 可能引起额外一次路线切换；这些事件不计入正式 0–60 秒性能窗口。

en: 5 Student experiment summaries for A and C
zh: 5 A 与 C 的学生实验汇总截图

items.en: Figure 10 Case A final student terminal summary. The unchanged legitimate route and before during after receiver metrics are shown.
items.zh: 图 10 A 场景学生终端最终汇总：合法路线保持不变，并列出异常前中后接收指标。

items.en: Figure 11 Case C final student terminal summary under the declared direct-link test condition.
items.zh: 图 11 C 场景学生终端最终汇总，实验采用已披露的直接链路测试条件。

items.en: The PASS outputs are supporting checks, not substitutes for interpretation. In both cases the affected edge lies outside the h1→h6 original route. Remaining on that route is therefore compatible with dynamic shortest-path routing. The cost and receiver curves on earlier pages provide the time-resolved evidence.
items.zh: PASS 输出只是辅助核验，不能代替分析。两种场景的受影响边都位于 h1→h6 原路之外，因此保持原路线符合动态最短路原则。前文代价和接收曲线提供了逐时证据。

en: 5 Student evidence for B and source blocking
zh: 5 B 场景与源封锁证据

items.en: Figure 12 Case B trial 3 terminal summary confirms rerouting, recovery and continued reception.
items.zh: 图 12 B 场景第 3 轮终端汇总，确认改道、恢复及持续接收。

items.en: Task 2 terminal evidence excerpt
items.zh: Task 2 终端证据摘录

items.en:
s2 flow inspection after the 8-second h2 flood
cookie=0xca230002  priority=5000
ip,nw_src=10.0.0.2  actions=drop
n_packets=478615  n_bytes=20101830
h2 → h6 ping: 3 sent, 0 received
h1 → h6 ping: 3 sent, 3 received
items.zh:
s2：8 秒 h2 flood 后检查流表
cookie=0xca230002  priority=5000
ip,nw_src=10.0.0.2  actions=drop
n_packets=478615  n_bytes=20101830

h1 → h6 ping：发送 3，接收 3

items.en: This is a typeset excerpt of the student-pasted terminal record, not a recreated screenshot [6]. The drop entry has no forwarding action. The lower-priority h2→h6 forwarding entry remains present, but the higher-priority source rule matches first. A rule’s presence and increasing drop counter, combined with failed blocked-source ping, demonstrate enforcement.
items.zh: 上述为学生粘贴终端记录的排版摘录，并非重新制作的截图 [6]。drop 项没有转发动作。较低优先级的 h2→h6 转发项仍可存在，但高优先级源规则先匹配。规则存在、drop 计数递增和异常源 ping 失败共同证明封锁生效。

items.en: B1 originally printed FAIL because its checker wrongly required a local ryu.log while the controller ran in an external student terminal. The original FAIL record was retained. A separate offline review verified the saved events, flow snapshots, receiver data and probes; B2 and B3 subsequently printed PASS directly. No earlier measurement was overwritten by a later successful trial.
items.zh: B1 最初打印 FAIL，原因是检查器误要求本地 ryu.log，而控制器实际运行在学生的外部终端。原 FAIL 记录保留，另存离线核验结果，检查已有事件、流表快照、接收数据与探测；之后 B2、B3 直接打印 PASS。后续成功实验没有覆盖早期观测。

zh: 6 结论 适用范围与 AI 使用声明

items.en: The tested controller meets the functional objective of combining source monitoring, EMA anomaly detection, IPv4 source blocking, load-aware cost updates and conditional legitimate rerouting. A and C isolate anomalies without moving an unaffected legitimate flow. In B, all three measurements show a lower-cost alternative selected during the anomaly and recovery to the original route afterwards. Stable legitimate UDP reception remains approximately 10 Mbps, with brief onset loss in B.
items.zh: 测试结果支持控制器将源流量监测、EMA 异常检测、IPv4 源封锁、负载感知代价和条件式合法改道集成实现。A、C 隔离异常，同时保持未受影响的合法路线；B 的三轮测量均显示异常期间选择更便宜的替代路线，并在之后恢复原路。合法 UDP 稳定接收约为 10 Mbps，B 在启动附近有短暂丢包。

items.en: The evaluation uses one topology and a 10 Mbps legitimate offered load, not a 40 Mbps saturation benchmark. A and C each have one measured trial; only B has three. The settings are justified operationally rather than optimized by a parameter sweep. Physical link failures were not evaluated: the current fixed-topology implementation stops route transactions if a switch or link disappears after readiness. Case C’s constrained test pair needs instructional confirmation, and post-block reactivation assumes the recorded attack path remains relevant.
items.zh: 评价仅覆盖一个拓扑和 10 Mbps 合法提供负载，没有进行 40 Mbps 饱和基准。A、C 各一轮，只有 B 重复三轮。参数有运行层面的理由，但没有通过扫描证明最优。未评价物理链路故障：当前固定拓扑实现遇到就绪后交换机或链路消失时会停止路由事务。C 的受约束测试对仍需教学确认；封锁后惩罚重激活还假设已记录攻击路径继续适用。

items.en: The implementation uses Ubuntu 22.04 under WSL2, Mininet 2.3.0 and Open vSwitch 2.17.12. MiniEdit uses system Python 3.10.12. The controller runs in a separate environment with Python 3.8.20, Ryu 4.34, eventlet 0.30.2 and NetworkX 2.6.3. items.zh: 环境为 WSL2 下的 Ubuntu 22.04、Mininet 2.3.0、Open vSwitch 2.17.12。MiniEdit 使用系统 Python 3.10.12；控制器使用独立环境 Python 3.8.20、Ryu 4.34、eventlet 0.30.2 和 NetworkX 2.6.3。教师源码原件保留不变；各阶段分别由 baseline_controller.py、anomaly_controller.py、dynamic_cost_controller.py 和 rerouting_controller.py 实现。

items.en: The Python module call runs the timed traffic and observation procedure in the current MiniEdit network object net. It is not the Ryu controller entry point. Between cases, exit the Mininet CLI, press Stop, stop the previous Ryu process and restart with the next scenario. The formal experiment records a complete 60-second legitimate stream, a 14-second flood beginning around second 12, per-second flow/port snapshots and receiver reports.
items.zh: Python 模块调用会在当前 MiniEdit 的网络对象 net 上运行定时流量和观测流程，它不是 Ryu 控制器入口。场景之间先退出 Mininet CLI、点击 Stop、停止上一 Ryu 进程，再启动下一场景。正式实验记录持续 60 秒的合法流、约第 12 秒开始的 14 秒 flood、逐秒流表与端口快照，以及接收端报告。

items.en: Each integrated run stores sender.log, receiver.log, continuous-ping.log, dataplane-samples.jsonl, initial/recovered evidence and a separate reviewed result. Frozen event snapshots and frozen B comparison inputs prevent later controller logging from changing the analysis source. Figures are copied byte-for-byte into this report’s assets folder with SHA256 provenance. The final Task 5 folder also contains per-second CSVs, original SVGs, summary JSON and validation records.
